stories.title: Shopify Mandates IP Allowlisting for Public Apps to Prevent Unauthorized Admin API Access

stories.title: OpenSSH Issues Emergency Fix for Flaw Letting Long Passwords Bypass SSH Auth on Alpine Linux
stories.description: OpenSSH 10.6p2 fixes a critical password bypass allowing access to key-only accounts on affected Alpine Linux servers using long passwords.

stories.title: Researchers Bypass ChatGPT Lockdown Mode to Exfiltrate Chats Without User Interaction
stories.description: A patched ChatGPT HTML preview flaw let crafted content bypass Lockdown Mode restrictions, enabling chat data exfiltration.

stories.title: GhostMap Android Flaw Can Trap Phones in Endless Reboot Loops Without Opening an App
stories.description: A new Android bug named GhostMap can leave a phone stuck in a crash loop after a user installs a single crafted app. The app does not need to be opened, asks for no permissions and holds no code.
